summary: MO-003 QRU Knowledge Record 2.0™ fully verified. Backend 13/13 pytest passed (serialized): /kr2/registry returns schema_version=2, section_count=36, all 10 groups (Core, Translations, Understanding, Verification, Application, Assessment, Media, Education, Visual, Relationships), and full status/source/verification value lists. /kr2/dependency-map returns product→section titles including teacher requirements (Executive Summary, Deep Explanation, Teacher Translation™, Question Library, Quiz Bank, Scientific References, Teacher Notes). POST /kr2/migrate is idempotent (same migrated count on repeat) and non-destructive (an edited section survives re-migration). GET /kr2/{id} returns 36 ordered sections keyed by section_id with every required field (title, content, status, source, verification_status, confidence_score, version, manufacturing_ready, depended_on_by[]) plus completeness{total,complete,verified,percent}; KR-00047 shows Executive Summary/Deep Explanation/QRU Translation™ as status=Verified, source=Imported with content preserved and Pending sections empty. PUT /kr2/{id}/section/{sid} increments version, sets manufacturing_ready=true when content present + status in Draft/Under Review/Verified/Approved; invalid status and invalid source both return 400. Readiness: KR-00047 + YouTube Video → allowed=false, missing includes both 'YouTube Script' and 'Image Concepts'; KR-00047 + Consumer Guide → allowed=true. Manufacturing gate: POST /automation/manufacture with product_types=['YouTube Video Script'] returns 400 with 'required Knowledge Record 2.0 sections are incomplete'. Frontend /kr2 fully verified: nav-kr2 renders and routes, kr2-selector loads 47 KRs, kr2-completeness shows '9/36 sections · 9 verified · 25% · schema v2' for KR-00047, kr2-sections lists exactly 36 SectionCards, cards expand to reveal kr2-content-<id> / kr2-status-<id> / kr2-save-<id>, edit + Save on story_version persists across reload with a v1 badge and status Draft. Regression: /inspection loads clean; /mfg-command renders with mfg-metrics grid intact.

issues: Version badge (v1) is fine but the '<span>' inside '<option>' React hydration warning comes from Emergent DevTools instrumentation on the KR selector — cosmetic, not a runtime bug. Consider ignoring or suppressing dev-only wrapper.

critical_code_review_comments: kr2/migrate runs .to_list(5000) — silent truncation risk if KRs ever exceed 5000; use a cursor iterator.

kr2/{kr_id} GET auto-migrates when schema_version != 2 but the migration is scoped by user role of the reader; any authenticated user can trigger a rewrite. Consider gating the auto-migrate branch to super_admin (POST /migrate already is).

PUT /section/{sid} silently overwrites author on first save from user['name'] — no audit history of prior authors kept; reviewer/version are captured but the append-only history is not. Fine for MO-003, worth logging for future.

manufacturing_readiness is a simple 'first-keyword-match' scan on lowercased product_type; 'Podcast Presentation' would match 'podcast' before 'presentation'. Order-of-insertion in DEPENDENCY_MAP determines the winner. Consider longest-keyword-first ordering.
Frontend KnowledgeRecord2.js — reload() approach on save is a full request; using the returned section from PUT to patch state locally would avoid the flicker (small polish).
Frontend uses /knowledge-records to populate the selector but shows only kr_code + title; adding schema_version + completeness percent would signal at-a-glance which KRs are architecturally rich.

seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Test-created TEST content on KR-00047 image_concepts and story_version was reset back to Pending/empty at the end of the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: KR 2.0 endpoints under /api/kr2/*. All 47 KRs live and migrated to schema_version=2. Manufacturing gate wired in /api/automation/manufacture (route in routers/automation.py — 400 with 'required Knowledge Record 2.0 sections are incomplete'). Frontend route /kr2, nav-kr2. Section testids: kr2-selector, kr2-completeness, kr2-sections, kr2-section-<key>, kr2-content-<key>, kr2-status-<key>, kr2-save-<key>. KR-00047 (Daytrading with Faith) is the canonical verified example: 9/36 sections filled (Executive Summary, Deep Explanation, QRU Translation™, Practical Applications, Memory Sentences™ all Verified/Imported; Scientific References too). Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration31_kr2.py uses pytestmark = xdist_group('kr2_serial') to keep KR-00047 mutation tests on one worker — pytest.ini's default '-n 2 --dist loadscope' scattering caused a race between TestManufacturingReadiness and TestSectionUpdate. Recommended run: `pytest test_iteration31_kr2.py -n 0` or `--dist loadgroup`. If future MOs modify KR-00047 sections, the polluted-state autouse fixture will still reset youtube_script/image_concepts/question_library/quiz_bank at session start.
rca of the issue: No defects. Initial two failures under parallel xdist were pure test-isolation artifacts on shared DB state (TestSectionUpdate populated image_concepts while TestManufacturingReadiness read it in another worker); fixed by grouping the file to a single xdist worker + autouse session fixture that resets test sections before assertions.
